# EMG

[Project home](../../../../README.md) · [Folder guide](../../../../Documentation/project_structure.md)

Available measured/pooled EMG envelopes, independently peak-normalized. phase_aligned_available_EMG.csv repeats no invented EMG for unmeasured groups.

- [EMG_PROVENANCE.json](EMG_PROVENANCE.json) — Identifies the EMG source, channel correspondence and normalization/availability limitations.
- [FHL_peak_normalized.tsv](FHL_peak_normalized.tsv) — Peak-normalized flexor hallucis longus EMG envelope used for shape comparison.
- [phase_aligned_available_EMG.csv](phase_aligned_available_EMG.csv) — Available peak-normalized EMG envelopes on the comparison phase grid. Only channels with available source EMG are represented.
